description: This PHP script manages option transfer configurations for double select boxes, including functions to set up transfer behaviors, initialize configurations, and handle item configurations within a web interface.

methods.name: opt_transf_cfg
methods.description: Configures the option transfer settings, including JavaScript event handlers and mapping of options between 'from' and 'to' select boxes.

methods.name: keywords_opt_transf_cfg
methods.description: Initializes and configures option transfer settings specifically for keyword options, setting size, style, and event handlers.

methods.name: opt_transf_empty_cfg
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty default configuration object for option transfer, with default styles and empty mappings.

methods.name: item_opt_transf_cfg
methods.description: Configures item-specific option transfer settings, similar to 'keywords_opt_transf_cfg' but for general items.
